title: Oozy Buttery Dutch Christmas Pudding Bake
description: A rich and indulgent vegetarian Dutch dish featuring Christmas pudding, topped with a sweet glaze and baked to perfection. This dish is perfect for the holiday season.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, brown sugar, heavy cream, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Crumble the Christmas pudding into the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
While the pudding is baking, prepare the glaze by whisking together the confectioners sugar and 2 tablespoons of heavy cream.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the glaze over the top of the pudding and sprinkle with chopped almonds if using.
Return the pudding to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until the glaze is caramelized.
